script:
Andrew (Religious Prisoner)
Congratulations, you have become Andrew
You believe in your own religion, although others see it as a non-existent cult. You were imprisoned for economic crimes. Although your cellmates don't believe it because they think you're crazy, it's actually true. You were originally an excellent business manager, but due to Johnny's gang's interference, you quickly went bankrupt. To save your business, you had to participate in a fraud case, and unfortunately, the matter was exposed and you were imprisoned. Your first cellmate brought you your current faith. You increasingly believe in karma. When you learned that Johnny had also been arrested after being imprisoned for some time, you became even more convinced that your faith was correct. In October this year, your first cellmate was released, and a strongman named Clark became your new cellmate. He's always mysterious and has a strange temperper. Although you often mutter to yourself in the cell and have drawn ghosts and gods all over the room, he hasn't bothered you and is unusually silent and taciturn. Later Johnny moved into 1602 alone, and his two subordinates moved into 1601. You rarely interact, but you curse Johnny once every day, completing a magical ritual. You believe that through divine power, you can make Johnny suffer inner condemnation and then repent and commit suicide. In fact, you planned to murder Johnny today, using a sharp object in the public bathroom to pierce his eardrum and then injure his brain causing death. Although you prepared a tool - a toothbrush with a sharpened end - you abandoned this plan because when Johnny was cleaning in the bathroom, guard Steven was standing outside the whole time, and you only saw this because you were responsible for cleaning the corridor today. Although you had already applied a layer of cleaning agent in the bathroom before they went to make the floor slippery, you never had a chance to act and could only return to your cell dejected. But you don't know where you threw the weapon - whatever, you didn't kill Johnny anyway.
Nothing happened that night, but early the next morning you were awakened by guard Steven, who informed you that Johnny had committed suicide. You were secretly pleased - your curse finally worked. It seems God was right, you must perform another sacrifice. But the detective who came said this might be murder rather than suicide, so you all became suspects.
Your Dark Side:
You have a detailed murder plan and prepared a weapon to try to murder Johnny, but failed. So the crime might still be suspected of you, so don't let them find evidence.
Character Relationships:

1601 John & Ken - You have no contact with them, just know of each other's existence. Anyway, you wouldn't have good feelings toward Johnny's subordinates
1603 Clark - Although in the same cell, he's always mysterious and you don't dare provoke him
Guard Steven - A typical representative of mercenary people, but he prevented your mission from succeeding today
Janitor George - You know each other, communicate little, no malice or resentment

Your Statement to the Detective:
Respected Detective:
I've always been an honest, law-abiding citizen. I was imprisoned entirely because of Johnny's framing. Although I hate Johnny very much, I don't have the guts to kill him. He has so many subordinates - wouldn't they take revenge on me when I get out? I was in my cell all last night. Although Clark was asleep and can't testify for me, how could I possibly get out of the cell? As for the last time I saw Johnny, it was yesterday afternoon during cleaning. Johnny was responsible for cleaning the bathroom, and I was responsible for cleaning the corridor. I saw Johnny in the bathroom from outside the door, but he didn't seem to be cleaning - more like sitting and resting. I didn't look carefully, but guard Steven was standing outside the bathroom the whole time, I don't know if it was to monitor Johnny or what. After cleaning, I was directly escorted back to my cell. That's it. Johnny and Steven must have a relationship. If this isn't a suicide case, then Steven must be the one who did it. Everyone else is a prisoner - it would be very difficult to leave the cell, and it wouldn't be easy to deal with Johnny either. Um, the specific reason for my imprisonment - Johnny sent people to suppress my company. To prevent my company from going bankrupt, I went to other companies for sponsorship, but the plan failed and I was imprisoned for fraud. That's how it is. So I've always hated Johnny. If it weren't for him, I wouldn't have lost my job and been imprisoned here. As for my faith, what's wrong with it? Didn't Johnny get his comeuppance? Believing in the great God is the only way to realize one's ideals, so why not believe in God's existence? When I get out, I must spread my God. That's all I have to say. I hope you solve the case quickly, Detective. I need to continue my ritual.
acts_goal:
Find the killer
Guard your dark side
